y.description: Values to use when computing the trapezoidal rule.

x.description: If specified, defines spacing between values as specified above.

dx.description: constant spacing between values. If neither :attr:`x` or :attr:`dx` are specified then this defaults to 1. Effectively multiplies the result by its value.

dim.description: The dimension along which to compute the trapezoidal rule. The last (inner-most) dimension by default.
